| description = Hardens the skin of your group, increasing their hit points, mana regeneration, and armor class for 1 hour(s) 40.0 mins.  Also known as PotG. The glades confer a great boon to any adventurer, unrestricted by normal Kunark era minimum level requirements. [[Aegolism]] and PotG do not stack with each other and neither will override the other.
